readout_other: EMG (needle electrode) of gastrocnemius; implanted ultrasonic mote temperature sensing at the nerve
direction_notes: FUS at the sciatic nerve induced gastrocnemius muscle contractions confirmed by EMG, with higher intensity giving larger EMG peaks; main finding is mote-measured heating up to about 0.77 C at 1745.83 mW/cm2.
safety_notes: Temperature rise at the nerve measured with implanted motes (up to about 0.77 C at 1745.83 mW/cm2); no tissue safety assessment in this study.

exposures.label: FUS of sciatic nerve, mouse hindlimb

target.label: sciatic nerves inside the lower hindlimb

timing.protocol_description: Ultrasonic pulse trains of 1-ms pulse duration and 10-Hz PRF applied to the sciatic nerve through a water-filled coupling cone at four Ispta levels (957.99, 1348.02, 1608.21, 1745.83 mW/cm2); train duration and duty cycle not stated.

source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: 1-ms pulse duration and 10-Hz pulse repetition frequency directly at the hindlimb to induce muscle contractions in the gastrocnemius muscle of the lower hindlimb (Fig. 4A)
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: 1-ms pulse duration and 10-Hz pulse repetition frequency directly at the hindlimb to induce muscle contractions in the gastrocnemius muscle of the lower hindlimb (Fig. 4A)
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: for generating ultrasound pulses with 3.57-MHz operating frequency and 1-ms pulse duration.
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.ispta_w_: Four stimulation intensities (957.99, 1348.02, 1608.21, and 1745.83 mW/cm<sup>2</sup>) were used in accordance with parameters found successful in a previous neuromodulation study (43) to stimulate the sciatic nerves at intensities proven safe under histological examination.
